Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
 
Your role in summary
The Senior Manager is a pivotal role within our team, responsible for developing and executing communication strategies and action plans. Organize and ensure the timely, budget-compliant completion of all project deliverables.
Support crisis communications under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Conduct research on policy issues at national, European, and international levels, and monitor legislation and regulations relevant to client’s business interests.
Undertake the people manager role, managing, training, guiding, and developing team members in accordance with company values and management processes.
Cooperate with external providers, ensuring performance and compliance with company policies.
Manage the completion of all client-related administrative tasks (databases, ISO files, etc.) on time and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Education & Experience 
 
Essential
- University degree in Business Administration, Media Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or Political Science

- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in a PR firm or in a Corporate Communication Department

description:
Your role is crucial in guiding a company's financial strategy, improving performance, and ensuring long-term financial health.
Key Responsibilities:

analysing financial results: after cleaning up the data, you analyse the historical information using ratios and metrics to determine patterns. Your job is to identify trends and compare the performance with other companies in the industry. You can evaluate the company's value and find ways to improve investment income from the analysis.
forecasting and making projections: your analysis reveals company performance predictions. You can find various financial models to help you make projections and predict the company's future performance. If you are analysing the viability of investment opportunities, the financial models help you make investment decisions.
developing recommendations: as a financial analyst, your job goes beyond crunching numbers and creating financial models. You provide recommendations on ways to improve business operations based on the projections. For instance, you list viable investment opportunities and suggest ways to improve revenue and market share. Aside from writing reports, you make presentations to clients and investors.
risk analysis: as a financial analyst, you can specialise in risk analysis and assess potential risks in a company's financial strategy. You help the managers identify sources of loss and minimise the risks involved in financial investments to increase profits.

description:

Commitment and follow through

title: Junior Java Developer / DevOps Engineer (Remote/Thessaloniki)
AI/ML Senior Associate Scientist
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAs a core member of our AI/ML, Quantitative & Digital Sciences (AQDS) team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain full-stack applications that integrate advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques with internal and external data sources.
Develop and apply generative AI techniques using large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of essential clinical trial documents.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop scalable, cloud-native microservices and APIs for AI/ML tools aimed at optimizing patient recruitment, site selection, and clinical trial management, incorporating generative AI capabilities to streamline authoring workflows.
Leverage modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue) to build intuitive user interfaces that provide real-time insights from ML models and facilitate decision-making for clinical operations, including AI-generated document review and customization.
Work closely with DevOps and data engineering teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure as code (IaC), and ensure secure deployment of AI/ML models, including generative AI systems, across cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Implement AI/ML models in full-stack systems, ensuring robust backend processing and efficient front-end data visualization.
Engage with both internal and external stakeholders to continuously bring the latest advancements in generative AI, full-stack development, and AI/ML technologies to Pfizer, contributing to thought leadership through publications and presentations.





ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner with key therapy areas (e.g., Immunology & Inflammation, Oncology, Internal Medicine) to identify scientific and technical challenges, define data pipelines, and implement full-stack solutions that leverage AI/ML methods, including generative AI models, to generate actionable insights and automate clinical trial documentation.
Translate complex clinical data and analytics requirements into full-stack digital products, ensuring that development priorities align with the overall clinical development goals.
Lead the end-to-end development of full-stack applications, from database schema design and API development to front-end user interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with AI/ML workflows and LLM-powered document generation systems.
Supervise and guide the deployment of robust back-end services that support predictive and classification algorithms, as well as generative AI models, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualization tools that provide clinical and operational teams with real-time analytics and insights driven by advanced ML models, while integrating tools for generating and reviewing AI-authored clinical trial documents.
Maintain an active external network in the AI/ML, generative AI, and full-stack development communities, continuously monitoring state-of-the-art capabilities and evaluating their potential impact on Pfizer's development teams.





QUALIFICATIONSBasic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in full-stack development in the pharma, biotech, or tech industry.
Proficient in full-stack development, including back-end technologies (Node.js, Django, Flask) and front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
Strong understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL) and experience in designing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
Experience with AI/ML model integration, including developing APIs to interface with ML models and building front-end components for real-time data visualization.
Experience working with large language models (LLMs) for generative AI applications.
Strong programming skills (Python, JavaScript, R) and familiarity with cloud technologies (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Computational Biology, Engineering).
Hands-on experience with the full-stack development of clinical trial management systems, focusing on integrating AI/ML-driven insights into clinical workflows, and automating document generation through LLMs.
Proven experience leading end-to-end clinicaldevelopment projects, particularly in Phases 2 and 3, from study design to regulatory submission.
Experience with data engineering workflows, including ETL processes, data lakes, and scalable data architectures.
Prior experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones is a plus.

title: Manager, Software Engineer
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.ROLE SUMMARYPfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications. Top candidates will also have experience working on regulated projects that have used an agile approach.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. In addition to standard software development and agile team responsibilities, SEs act as mentors as well as technical subject matter experts on in-house, outsourced, and co-sourced developed global applications. SEs may additionally lead technical teams and work independently or lead others on initiatives. SEs will collaborate closely with stakeholders of all levels across both the Digital Core Solutions organization as well as our partner business operations organizations, leading to opportunities to learn from and advise senior Pfizer leadership.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Works independently and within teams to advance organizational and project objectives.
Works with project teams across R&D Solutions, providing technical leadership across business domains, including support for short and long-term strategies in alignment with Pfizer Digital colleagues: Client Partners, Architects, Solution Delivery Leads, among others.
Participates in Agile practices in alignment with team processes and objectives.
Designs application areas to meet project objectives and alignment with Digital standards and best practices.
Works in team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Ensures the expectations and requirements of internal and external stakeholders are met.
Provides technical management of colleagues and contract resources for software development projects.
Provides technical expertise and oversight to ensure the quality and maintenance of existing production systems.
Suggests and assists in the development of Engineering Best Practices for the group.
Designs, prototypes, implements and unit tests software solutions in supported business areas.
Specifies user/system interfaces and translates logical designs into physical designs taking account of target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
Produces detailed designs and documents all work using required standards, methods and tools, including prototyping tools, where appropriate.
Conducts reviews of supplied specifications as appropriate.
Creates, improves, and maintains DevOps and other build and code management configurations to support efficient, high quality, and secure software development and delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS ​

Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering, Information Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other scientific or engineering discipline.
5+ years of relevant experience within the Software Engineering discipline.
Experience working within teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated capabilities and experience collaborating and working effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Experience in supporting the selection or implementation of technical direction on large projects and/or complex, program-level initiatives requiring technical and business-domain expertise.
Experience and demonstrated competencies either informally or formally managing and/or mentoring others with an emphasis on communicating software engineering and project development best practices.
Demonstrated focus on the high quality of outputs through various methods, such as through code quality initiatives, implementation of automated testing or a unit testing program, process improvement, or leading team engagement with quality initiatives.

Required Capabilities and Experience:

Strong capabilities in developing multi-tiered solutions using Java/J2EE, JBoss Application Server, SQL, REST and JMS, as well as web technologies and frameworks such as Angular, Typescript, HTML, CSS.
Experience using Agile and DevOps tools such as Jira, GitHub and Sonar.
Demonstrated capabilities in understanding data and integration architectures to manage, transform, and exploit data across the enterprise.
Capable of understanding security requirements and using the frameworks and tools the organization has put in place to meet those requirements.
Excellent oral and written communication skills including technical writing / documentation.

Required Aptitude:

Quick to establish trust and respect
Action oriented and energetic
Resourceful and creative
Persistent and determined
Mature and cool under pressure
Easily makes connections
Reads situations quickly
Commitment and follow through

title: Director, AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead
description:
Role SummaryDo you want to make an impact on patient health around the world? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that brings together scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Then join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) where you can leverage cutting-edge technology to inform critical business decisions and improve customer experiences for our colleagues, patients and physicians. Our collection of engineering, data science, and AI professionals are at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization that leverages data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team within Data Science Solutions and Initiatives is a critical driver and enabler of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading the process and engineering innovation to rapidly progress early AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As the AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead, you will be a leader within the Data Science Industrialization team charged with driving the development of web application frontends, particularly those focused on AI use cases. Your responsibilities will span both technical leadership and hands-on development. You will lead a global team and partner with cross-functional business stakeholders and Digital leaders to catalyze identification, design, iterative development, and continuous improvements of web applications that enable use case delivery. Your team will develop best practices and maintain standards for frontend application development. Your team will be accountable to key Pfizer business functions (including Pfizer Biopharma, R&D, PGS, Oncology, and Enabling Functions) for developing Web solutions that support business objectives across all of Pfizer's core business units.



Role Responsibilities

Architecting Solutions: You'll lead the design and architecture of frontend applications, ensuring they align with business goals and technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, product managers, and designers, to define technical roadmaps and prioritize features.
Mentoring and Guidance: Provide guidance to junior frontend developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both Angular and React is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Collaboration with Designers: Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to create consistent and delightful user experiences.
Responsive Design: Ensure applications are designed to work seamlessly across various devices and screen sizes.
Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.
Set a vision, prioritize workstreams, and provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and mentorship for a global team with technical & functional expertise.
Coach direct reports to adopt best practices, improve technical skills, develop an innovative mindset, and achieve professional growth through technical and organizational thought leadership.




QualificationsMust-Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or engineering related area.
10+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
2-3 years of hands-on experience leading software engineering teams
Track record of managing stakeholder groups and effecting change
Recognized by peers as an expert in software, with deep expertise in frontend solution architecture, and hands-on development
Expert knowledge of frontend technologies; familiar with Angular, React,HTML/CSS/Bootstrap​.
Deep understanding of digital accessibility and disability inclusion. Experience developing digital products that comply with accessibility standards.

title: Βοηθός Λογιστή - Υπεύθυνος Τιμολόγησης
description:
Περιγραφή θέσης εργασίας
Η SIPCAM HELLAS, με έδρα το Κορωπί, αναζητά έναν αξιόπιστο Βοηθό Λογιστή - Υπεύθυνο Τιμολόγησης για την εκτέλεση εργασιών που θα μας βοηθήσουν να παρακολουθούμε τα έσοδά μας. 
Θα είστε υπεύθυνος/η κυρίως για την έκδοση παραστατικών Τιμολόγησης (χονδρικής, υπηρεσιών, κτλ), Αποστολής, Ενδοδιακίνησης και Πιστωτικών (επιστροφής πώλησης, διόρθωσης τιμής, έγκαιρης εξόφλησης, εκπτώσεις προώθησης, εκπτώσεις τζίρου, κτλ) και την ενημέρωση των αρχείων.
Ως Υπάλληλος Τιμολόγησης, πρέπει να είστε ακριβείς και αξιόπιστοι στον χειρισμό λογαριασμών και εγγράφων. Οι μαθηματικές ικανότητες και το υψηλό επίπεδο οργανωτικότητας είναι απαραίτητα λόγω του μεγάλου όγκου οικονομικών πληροφοριών. Δεδομένου ότι θα χρησιμοποιείτε εφαρμογές τεχνολογίας για να επιταχύνετε την εργασία σας, απαιτούνται γνώσεις πληροφορικής (ERP EnterSoft, Excel).
Στόχος είναι να συμβάλλετε στην ακριβή προετοιμασία των εισπρακτέων λογαριασμών και να διασφαλίσετε τα έσοδα της επιχείρησης.
Η θέση αναφέρεται στον προϊστάμενο λογιστηρίου.
Αρμοδιότητες
•    Γνώση όλου του κυκλώματος OTC (Order to Cash process)από την λήψη παραγγελιών έως την είσπραξη. •    Διαχείριση ισοζυγίου λογαριασμών (εμπορικό, γενικής λογιστική) για την εξεύρεση οφειλών ή άλλων ανακολουθιών.•    Ενημέρωση τιμοκαταλόγων.•    Εφαρμογή και παρακολούθηση της εμπορικής πολιτικής.•    Συλλογή όλων των πληροφοριών που απαιτούνται σύμφωνα με την εμπορική πολιτική για τον υπολογισμό των εισπρακτέων λογαριασμών (ποσά εντολών, εκπτώσεων κτλ.)•    Εισαγωγή και έλεγχος των δεδομένων στο λογιστικό σύστημα για την εξασφάλιση της ακρίβειας του τελικού λογαριασμού.•    Έκδοση παραστατικών (τιμολόγια χρέωσης - πίστωσης) και λογαριασμών και αποστολή στους πελάτες μέσω διαφόρων καναλιών (πχ. e-invoice, ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο κτλ.)•    Έλεγχος αποθήκης (εισαγωγές, εξαγωγές, παραγωγή, παρτίδες, ποσότητες, αξίες, κόστος πωλήσεων, κτλ) και εξασφάλιση του μικτού περιθωρίου ανά προϊόν σύμφωνα με την εμπορική πολιτική.•    Έλεγχος υπολοίπου πελατών, αναλυτικών γραμμών (open items) και ληξιπρόθεσμων (aging)•    Έκδοση αντιγράφων λογαριασμών πελατών περιοδικά ή όποτε είναι απαραίτητο.•    Αποστολή υπενθυμίσεων για πληρωμές και επικοινωνία με τους πελάτες.•    Ενημέρωση λογιστικών εγγραφών με νέες πληρωμές, υπόλοιπα, στοιχεία πελατών κτλ.•    Απάντηση ερωτήσεων σχετικά με λογαριασμούς.•    Ενημέρωση διοίκησης σχετικά με τη δραστηριότητα (reporting).
Απαιτήσεις
•    Αποδεδειγμένη εμπειρία σε θέση υπαλλήλου τιμολόγησης ή γενική εμπειρία λογιστικής•    Τήρηση της σχετικής νομοθεσίας (ΕΛΠ, ΦΠΑ, MyData)•    Άριστη γνώση Excel και χειρισμού σχετικού λογισμικού (ERP)•    Εξαιρετικές μαθηματικές, οργανωτικές και δεξιότητες επικοινωνίας•    Τίτλοι σπουδών (ΑΕΙ, ΤΕΙ ή ΙΕΚ Λογιστικής, Διοίκησης Επιχειρήσεων, Οικονομικών) 
Προσωπικά Χαρακτηριστικά
•    Αναλυτική Σκέψη•    Ικανότητα αποτελεσματικής επικοινωνίας και οργάνωσης•    Ικανότητα διαχείρισης πολλαπλών εργασιών και προτεραιοποίησης•    Προσαρμοστικότητα & ευελιξία•    Ικανότητα επίλυσης προβλημάτων•    Πνεύμα συνεργασίας & ομαδικότητας•    Αποτελεσματική διαχείριση χρόνου
Παροχές

You are a strong team player and show enthusiasm for supporting the development of others, but you can also easily work independently.

You are eager to learn and able to stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies

 
If you're ready to take your career to the next level in a challenging international environment, focusing on continuous learning and dynamic teamwork, both in Greece and abroad, you're ready for Deloitte!

description:
Join INTRALOT as a Software Engineer (React)!

As a Software Engineer (React) at INTRALOT, you'll play a pivotal role in our Digital iLottery Projects!

 Participating in all phases of the development life cycle, focusing on coding and unit testing.

Staying up to date with emerging technologies and formulating concepts and ideas for additional products, tools and services to be provided.

 You hold a University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or relevant technology-related field.
 At least three (3) years of experience in Software Development.

 Excellent understanding of the entire web development process (Design, Development and Deployment).You have an excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken
  We work better as a TEAM. So, you also have to be an excellent team player.

Nice to have, but not necessary:
Experience in developing and maintaining high-quality React Native applications using clean code.

 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family.

 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status. Detail- oriented and excellent concentration ability

Experience in Mobile Development

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Operations Management, Data Science, or a related field.

Excellent project management skills, with a track record of successfully leading large-scale analytics projects.

This role may require occasional travel to sites for team collaboration and stakeholder meetings.

We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments.  Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management practices.

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures.
Experience in performance monitoring tools like Kibana/New Relic/Wormly/Lighthouse/Xhprof/Blazemeter is a plus.
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.

description:

The Customer & Commercial Creation Centre (C4) team creates technology solutions for our external customers. This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites.

This includes our Marketing Technology (Martech) platform.
Our mission over the next few years is to change how customer data is managed, from fragmented implementations to a coherent customer-data ecosystem of services dedicated to the collection and management of profiles, consents and organised data. We also aim to improve the marketer experience and to improve patient outcomes through tools that enable our marketing teams to create finely tuned, intelligent and relevant audiences, messages and journeys that can be activated across any or all of our channel options.
We seek an experienced full stack engineer versed in Adobe Fusion and/or Salesforce Automation Studio to join our team as an engineering lead working in our team building CRM data integration and automation services that supply data from CDP and other sources to our campaign journey orchestration & activation services. This team also maintains several web applications that support the management and operations of our data.You will be responsible for many aspects of solution architecture and technical design for the services you work on. This includes Adobe Fusion flows, AWS infrastructure, APIs and contracts, Laravel/Vue.js web applications, test strategy, performance, reliability, security and compliance. You will be supported by contract solution architects and other experienced engineers, but the expectation is that you become the engineering authority and source of truth and experience for your services.You will work with the PO and BA to design, refine and deliver solutions that meet business requirements but also our mission of building globally scalable, secure and supportable platforms. To achieve this, you will need to weigh short term business deliverables against longer term sustainability.

Core responsibility: Product & service delivery
That the team produce fit-for-purpose solutions is the ultimate measure of your success, with you working closely with product owners to discuss and understand vision, strategy and help everyone deliver tactical next steps.This involves:

Understanding the overall roadmap, context and direction of the product and key partner teams by being part of the conversations and helping guide the roadmap.
Leading the estimation and working with the PO on prioritization of requirements
Working with platform architects and Enterprise Architecture to create an appropriate solution architecture and technical design that meets the business needs and our long-term objectives.
Refining stories as part of team refinement sessions, bringing expertise to bear in defining the right solution design, acceptance criteria and testing criteria
Coordinating execution within the team as well as writing code yourself. Key languages and tools include:

Front end applications: Laravel and Vue.js
Back end: Python
Platforms: Salesforce Automation Studio (plus elements of Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud) / Adobe Experience Manager (inc. Fusion, Workfront, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics)


Ensuring the team write documentation as required,including in-line code commentary, GitHub .MD documentation and confluence SDLC documentation that describes:

The purpose of the software
The CI environment and deployment processes
Development standards and processes
Architecture, API and Design
Architectural Decision Records
How to develop the application(s) locally as a new developer on the team
Processes and checks for deployment to the cloud environments



Qualifications & Education
Key Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years' experience with increasing responsibility developing digital solutions, products, and services.
Professional certifications in software engineering fields are a bonus
Proven experience in software engineering, with a focus on roles in complex global enterprise projects
Excellent experience with Laravel, Vue.js and Python, along with Typescript, SQL and other components common to full stack delivery.
Good experience of the Adobe and/or Salesforce marketing automation platforms including key technologies like Workfront, Fusion or Automation Studio
Excellent knowledge of AWS services
Excellent experience writing automated tests (Unit, Integration, etc)
Excellent experience with API-led development.
Excellent experience with Agile team processes, including Scrum, Scrumban.
Experience with the types of process problems that come when trying to build complex, new applications and comfortable when things are uncertain and require problem solving.

Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to establish relationships, influence outcomes, and deliver effective presentations to a variety of audiences.
Strong written and spoken English

title: Machine Learning Specialist
description: On behalf of our client, ELPEDISON, we are looking to recruit a Machine Learning Specialist.This role offers a direct contractual association with Elpedison, ensuring that you become an integral part of our client's payroll and contribute your skills to their esteemed organization. Please be aware that our role is exclusively focused on overseeing the recruitment process.The companyElpedison is the first independent energy utility in Greece, and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with enthusiasm in what we do and we pride ourselves of offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. Now we are offering a set of exciting positions in our headquarters in Athens, to incite our new digital transformation program. If you are skilled in data management, data science, advanced analytics, technology project management, or related fields, this can be a big opportunity for YOUR career.Responsibilities Leverages machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies to develop data-driven solutions. Identifies potential use cases and collaborates with business stakeholders to mature the use of AI/ML within their respective organizations. Designs and develops machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence software to automate business tasks and provide predictive models. Builds and maintains an inventory of current and potential future AI/ML use cases to improve awareness and understanding of AI/ML potential value. Provides high-level AI/ML subject matter expertise to inform strategic decisions and project planning. Designs and develops ML algorithms and AI software to automate business tasks and provide predictive models, and integrates them into software systems. Transforms data science prototypes and applies appropriate ML algorithms and tools. Solves complex problems with multi-layered data sets, and optimizes existing machine learning libraries and frameworks. Monitors machine learning models in production to ensure they continue to perform effectively and generate accurate user recommendations. Pfizer Worldwide Medical and Safety colleagues play a key role in connecting evidenced based, medical decision support with colleagues and stakeholders to enable better health and treatment outcomes. title: Manager, AWS Developer
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.
What You Will Achieve
Your technical skills will help us develop and support robust softwares for our business. Due to your expertise, you will develop program logic for new applications and modify existing ones. You will support a range of activities, such as coding, testing, debugging, documentation, implementation and maintenance of software applications and cloud infrastructure for Pfizer.As a Manager, you will take ownership of long running tasks and goals. Your planning skills will help in preparing requirements, and providing areas of improvement for products, processes or services. Through your comprehensive knowledge of principles, concepts and theories of the discipline, you will also work towards advancing new concepts and methodologies. You will be able to take a leadership role to facilitate agreements between different teams.It is your hard work and dedication that will help in making Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe.
How You Will Achieve It

Provide guidance, lead/co-lead projects, manage own time to meet objectives and plan resource requirements for projects across the department.
Prepare and deliver operational updates to business stakeholder groups and solution delivery leads.
Ensure alignment across the Pfizer Digital organization and service providers effectively utilizing the Pfizer Digital organization.
Create a culture of Continuous Improvement including creating new projects focused on technical and organizational issues and monitoring improvement efforts.
Work with contract resources to deliver services, projects & operating support models for delivered solutions and ensure technology solutions meet the needs of the business.
Establish an environment where the team can be as effective as possible, addressing team dynamics, and ensuring a good relationship between the development team and product owner.
Manage global digital services in conjunction with the product & service owners.
Identify opportunities to decommission applications or move to regional or global solutions.
Drive Application rationalization to reduce local applications to the absolute minimum.

Qualifications
Must-Have

BSc degree is required.
5+ years' relevant experience.
2+ years' experience with AWS, Azure, and/or Google public cloud experience in a production environment.
Experience with developing secure cloud based applications using languages such as Python and Typescript.
Experience designing, orchestrating, and deploying container based solutions using Docker and related AWS services.

title: Electrical Technician / One&Only Kéa Island
description:
At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn.   
Shimmering in the depths of the azure Aegean Sea, a story-filled island of myths and marvels, One&Only Kéa Island emerges to honour untold beauty with authentic flavours of Greece. The warm Mediterranean hospitality is one of our most unique and valued assets. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect family day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
About the role
Responsible for maintenance and proper functionality of electrical systems and devices. Daily on-site inspections, interventions and reporting. Ensuring that safety measures are followed.
Key Duties and Responsibilities

Daily on site inspecting of electrical systems, filling of check lists and acting per instructions of direct superiors.
Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components to locate the cause of a breakdown and perform reparation/replacement on faulty elements, utilizing hand and power tools.
To follow preventive maintenance calendar and to ensure that all activities are performed accordingly.
Closely cooperate with team leader about given tasks and activities.
To be familiar with safety standards and legal requirements and to followed them in daily activities.
To respond promptly and accurately on maintenance request and work orders.
Timely and accurately reporting to superiors and relevant parties about completed and uncompleted tasks.
Record of all activities has to be properly filled-in in the maintenance software.
Lights checking and bulbs replacement.
Responsible for inventory and proper condition of personal tools, and large tools which are provided to the electricians on as-needed base. To report immediately about any failures or breakages.
Responsible for cleanliness and organization of electrical rooms and workshop.
Monitoring of electricity consumption and report immediately if any deviation is noted.
Searching for potential improvements in order to reduce consumption and improve work quality.
To follow up room maintenance as per Perfect Room Program
To attend department meetings.
To follow up spare parts stock and to inform superior timely when refilling is needed.
To liaise, actively support and assist to the other technicians on any issue.
To be familiar with the buildings BoH and public areas, all pieces of equipment and installation (electrical cabinets, cable routing, control panels, BMS, room management system, Lutron, Access control, CCTV, FLS systems, electricity meters and other electrical devices…).
To be familiar with main shut ’offs (water, electricity, heating and cooling, LPG) and to react quickly in a case of emergency.
To be familiar with FLS systems and procedures.
To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Skills, Experience & Educational Requirements

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.
Proven success working in a team.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals.
Excellent problem-solving ability.
Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.

Design, develop, and deliver AI and generative AI products.
Collaborate effectively with a global and talented cross-functional team made up of data scientists and solution engineers to set high development standards, drive strategic workstreams, and achieve targeted business outcomes.
Engage with stakeholders across the enterprise to understand and solve complex problems by integrating advance AI/ML techniques and hybrid software engineering solutions to inform business strategy and decisions and achieve objective key results.
Research, identify, and apply new algorithms and technological offerings to solve complex problems and systematize solutions into reusable assets and capabilities.
Identify emerging technologies, stay up to date with current trends and opportunities, evaluate their potential impact, and make informed decisions on adopting new tools, frameworks, and methodologies.

Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) majors with quantitative emphasis - Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent work experience
5+ years as a software engineer, AI/ML engineer, or data scientist and product lead for a wide diverse range of projects, with a focus on developing and deploying production-grade solutions.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, React, and/or C++, and proficiency with AI and machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn). Applied knowledge of statistical analysis, experience with R, Excel, etc.
Strong background in computer science: algorithms, data structures, machine learning, and distributed systems.
Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing AI and data technology strategies
Superior analytical skills with an eye for attention to details required, strong verbal, written, communication, and story-telling skills with ability to adapt and connect across a variety of audiences. This includes the capacity to communicate complex situational opportunities, challenges, or analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner to team leads and business partners.
Demonstrated experience interfacing with other internal and external teams to incorporate their innovations and vice versa
Deep knowledge of current and emerging AI, ML, and data technologies relevant to pharmaceutical research.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
Advanced understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning architectures, and statistical techniques.
Experience with foundation models, LLMs, and generative AI.
Proficiency in data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction.
Familiarity with software engineering principles (e.g. version control, testing, and deployment)
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and distributed computing frameworks is a plus.
Experience working in Agile scrum methodology or scaled SAFE design.

About the role
Responsible for maintenance and proper functionality of electrical systems and devices. Daily on-site inspections, interventions and reporting. Ensuring that safety measures are followed.

Daily on site inspecting of electrical systems, filling of check lists and acting per instructions of direct superiors.
Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components to locate the cause of a breakdown and perform reparation/replacement on faulty elements, utilizing hand and power tools.
To follow preventive maintenance calendar and to ensure that all activities are performed accordingly.
Closely cooperate with team leader about given tasks and activities.
To be familiar with safety standards and legal requirements and to followed them in daily activities.
To respond promptly and accurately on maintenance request and work orders.
Timely and accurately reporting to superiors and relevant parties about completed and uncompleted tasks.
Record of all activities has to be properly filled-in in the maintenance software.
Lights checking and bulbs replacement.
Responsible for inventory and proper condition of personal tools, and large tools which are provided to the electricians on as-needed base. To report immediately about any failures or breakages.
Responsible for cleanliness and organization of electrical rooms and workshop.
Monitoring of electricity consumption and report immediately if any deviation is noted.
Searching for potential improvements in order to reduce consumption and improve work quality.
To follow up room maintenance as per Perfect Room Program
To attend department meetings.
To follow up spare parts stock and to inform superior timely when refilling is needed.
To liaise, actively support and assist to the other technicians on any issue.
To be familiar with the buildings BoH and public areas, all pieces of equipment and installation (electrical cabinets, cable routing, control panels, BMS, room management system, Lutron, Access control, CCTV, FLS systems, electricity meters and other electrical devices…).
To be familiar with main shut ’offs (water, electricity, heating and cooling, LPG) and to react quickly in a case of emergency.
To be familiar with FLS systems and procedures.
To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.
Proven success working in a team.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals.
Excellent problem-solving ability.
Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.

Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#

Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor

Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.
 
Responsibilities

Work closely with a business analysts’ team and stakeholders to design and implement the best solutions.
Follow industry’s best practices and standards.
Test and deliver high-quality software.

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.

Experience in building rich responsive/adaptive web UIs with HTML5 and CSS3.

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#
